description:
## What's new

- **Sharper, cleaner share pictures.** The story card now draws the artwork big and sharp, with the title, artist, the Lunara icon and a “Listen on Lunara” sign-off — no QR code, no link text cluttering the picture. The link still travels with the image when you send it.
- **Share key on the player.** A share button now sits at the top right of Now Playing, next to every other share menu.
- **Links open straight in Lunara.** Shared links are verified App Links on lunara.ankitak.com.np — no more “Open with” chooser once the site is live.
